title: Introduce hook-policy-gate, init-safety admission webhook and sealed-values serializer
author: Ava Patel
commits: 9a3f8c2: introduce sealed-values serializer and test harness
b4e1d7a: add admission webhook deployment and RBAC templates
d2c6b41: implement hook-policy-gate values and template helpers
f7a9e0b: add chart docs and values examples for private installer
c5d8f12: fix helm lint warnings and update chart schema
description:
Context:
This PR adds a compact admission webhook and a sealed-values serializer to the private Helm chart to enable safer init jobs and enforce hook policy gates at install/upgrade time for on-prem/VPC deployments. Motivation: during private installs we occasionally observed init hooks that mutated namespace-scoped secrets and ran concurrently, causing race conditions and intermittent failures. The goal is to provide a minimal, opt-in safety layer that validates hook policies, seals sensitive portions of the values blob, and exposes templating helpers so operator teams can opt into stricter semantics without changing existing recipes.

What I changed (single continuous description):
- Add an admission webhook deployment and Service/ServiceMonitor templates; webhook validates that init hooks declare "hookPolicy" metadata and ensures the hook runs with declared concurrency and timeout fields when enabled.
- Introduce charts/private/_sealed_serializer.tpl and a small Go-based serializer container image (packaging config only) that produces a compact sealed blob; values.schema.json extended with a "sealedValues" top-level object to accept sealed blobs for air-gapped installs.
- Add hook-policy-gate.yaml template which injects annotations and sidecar hints into hook Jobs when policy enforcement is enabled.
- Provide init-job-safe-probe.yaml: optional liveness/readiness probes for init jobs triggered by Helm hooks so the chart can detect hung init workers and fail fast.
- Extend _helpers.tpl with new template functions: includeHookMeta, renderSealedValue and safeMergeValues to reduce repetitive templating in downstream overlays.
- Update README with examples for converting secrets to sealedValues and a simple migration path for existing customers.

Testing performed and CI notes: built charts locally and ran helm lint; added new unit chart tests under charts/private/tests that exercise sealed-values decoding in a lightweight k3s integration harness. Initial integration run failed due to RBAC scoping for the webhook; fixed RBAC rules and reran. All CI checks passed after the fix.

Rollout and backward compatibility: default behavior is unchanged (feature gated off). Operators can opt into the admission webhook and sealed-values flow via values.disableHookPolicyGate=false and by supplying values.sealedValues.blob. The migration guide in README explains how to create sealed blobs using the provided serializer container image and how to fall back to plain values for older installs.

Alternatives considered: embedding policy checks purely in Helm templates was considered but rejected because Helm runs client-side and cannot enforce runtime concurrency across clustered job scheduling; an admission webhook provides a more robust enforcement mechanism.

Release notes and follow-ups: this PR introduces opt-in security controls for private installs. Follow-up tasks: publish serializer container image to our internal registry, add e2e scenarios to perf-canary, and coordinate with private-installer team to add a preflight check that validates sealed blob signatures.
review_comments: Diego Morales: Can we avoid adding a cluster-wide ClusterRole? We need to document the minimum RBAC required for restricted tenants.
Ava Patel: Reply: switched to namespace-scoped Role with a short-lived ServiceAccount; updated templates to create rolebindings per-namespace when namespaceScopedRBAC=true. Added docs note.
Priya Srinivasan: We should ensure the webhook has observability (metrics). Can the ServiceMonitor be optional so it doesn't require Prometheus for air-gapped installs?
Ava Patel: Reply: made ServiceMonitor conditional on values.monitoring.enabled and added a simple /metrics endpoint stub in the serializer container config.
release_notes: Add opt-in admission webhook and sealed-values support for private Helm chart; introduces hook policy gate and templating helpers to enforce safe init hook behavior (opt-in, non-breaking).
